questions.question: The apostle Paul told the believers in Corinth that their body is what?

answers.text: A temple of the Holy Spirit

questions.question: Paul told the Corinthian believers they were bought at a price. What did he say to do with their body?
Paul wrote that every other sin is outside a man's body. What did he say makes sexual sin different?

answers.text: It is a sin against his own body
It only harms the other person
It is a sin nobody can see
